editorial:
Ever wonder what actually happens inside your computer when things crash? You get to find out in this wild ride where a young YouTuber ends up trapped inside the web. You will follow Alice as she navigates a neon-colored digital land filled with weird characters and glitches. The vibe is super energetic and feels like a modern version of Alice in Wonderland, but with wifi and social media instead of rabbit holes. It is a bright, colorful adventure that captures how much kids today live their lives online, making it feel relatable and fresh for the whole family.

What really works here is the imaginative world-building and the funny battle against the evil Queen of Bots. The pacing stays quick, though some of the special effects can feel a bit simple in a few spots. Still, the acting is great and keeps you rooting for Alice to get home. If you are looking for a fun movie night, you should definitely stream this in 4K Ultra HD on Prime Video for the best colors, or maybe grab the 4K Blu-ray to keep in your physical collection for the kids.
endingExplained: After a big final showdown, Alice uses her knowledge of the internet to outsmart the Queen of Bots. She realizes that the digital world is fueled by attention and likes, so she manages to shut down the Queen's power. This opens a portal that lets her jump back into the real world. She wakes up at her desk, realizing that spending time with real people is way more important than getting views on her channel.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves digital worlds and family adventures
